0.text: The AI Agent Platform uses LangGraph for orchestration, FAISS for vector search, and spaCy for named entity recognition. Documents are chunked, embedded with sentence transformers, and stored in a FAISS index for semantic retrieval. Each tenant has isolated access to their own documents.

1.text: An AI agent platform allows users to submit tasks. The platform uses LangGraph for orchestration, FAISS for vector search, and Neo4j for graph memory. Tasks go through planning, tool calling, execution, and verification steps.
